title: Monitor Latency x Fast Agentic Loops: Compounding Through Speed Mismatch

original_idea.body: Simulate an agent acting at rate R with an async monitor of latency L, inject a harmful action, and measure cascade size vs L/R plus the latency budget needed for containment.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Latency-cascade dynamics inform whether async monitoring can be a backstop, but pure timing simulation has a gap to concrete catastrophic-harm reduction.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Discrete-event simulation, no model needed; highly accessible.

novelty.reasoning: Async monitoring discussed; the explicit cascade-vs-latency simulation may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Async-monitoring discussed; the cascade simulation may be open.
